Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced an incorrect Wikipedia snippet showing John Schlesinger’s birth year as 1963 (instead of the correct 1926) and did not immediately validate it. This wrong date would make Tran Anh Hung (1962) appear older and could lead to the incorrect conclusion that “I Come With The Rain” has the director born first.
